title: Terminal set to the wrong currency

referral.merchant_message: Canadian customers' cards are failing since we moved the terminal from our pop-up shop.

steps.text: I'll start by looking up the merchant, the transaction, and any earlier referrals — all in parallel.

result.decline_reason: currency not supported by terminal configuration

steps.text: Good, I have the merchant and transaction details. Now let me check the card status and run sanctions screening on both the merchant name and its owner.

All checks are complete. Here's my summary:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| **Merchant** | Maple & Pine Outfitters, owner Claire Dubois, verified, trading 1,430 days |
| **Sanctions (merchant)** | Score 0.32 — clear |
| **Sanctions (owner)** | Score 0.40 — clear |
| **Card status** | Active |
| **Amount** | 212 CAD ≈ £114.48 — under £5,000 |
| **Merchant risk** | Recent volume (55) well within expected (60); trading > 30 days |
| **Duplicate** | No earlier referrals |
| **Decline reason** | "currency not supported by terminal configuration" |

The decline reason is specific and matches the merchant's own description: after moving the terminal from their pop-up shop, it appears the terminal is now configured for GBP rather than CAD. Canadian-issued cards presenting in CAD are being rejected because the terminal doesn't accept that currency. The fix is a terminal configuration update.

input.message_to_merchant: Thank you for getting in touch. The transaction was declined because the terminal's currency configuration does not currently support the currency on the cards being presented (CAD). This is likely a result of the terminal settings changing when you moved it from your pop-up shop. Please contact your terminal provider to ensure CAD is enabled in the terminal's currency configuration, and transactions should then process as expected.
input.reason: Decline reason is 'currency not supported by terminal configuration'. The merchant relocated their terminal and it is now set to GBP, rejecting CAD-denominated cards. No sanctions, fraud, high-value, merchant-risk, or duplicate concerns. Straightforward configuration issue.
